title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (w/m/d)
description:

Deine Rolle

Du baust robuste Services und APIs in Kotlin, Java oder TypeScript und bringst sie in unsere Web-Apps, gern auch bis in die Infrastruktur.

Du konzipierst, entwickelst und testest neue Backend-Services und Features im engen Austausch mit Deinen Kolleg*innen aus Frontend und Backend. Dabei gestaltest Du Datenmodelle, Schnittstellen und Integrationen mit Drittsystemen.

Du sorgst für Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Sicherheit unserer Web-Plattformen und Services. Mit unseren Kunden arbeitest Du direkt an der technischen und inhaltlichen Ausgestaltung.

Deine typische Woche

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und testest neue Features, von der API bis zur Oberfläche

  • Du programmierst im Backend in Kotlin, Java oder TypeScript (Node.js) und im Frontend in TypeScript (React)

  • Du designst Datenmodelle, Schnittstellen und Integrationen mit Drittsystemen und verbindest sie sauber mit dem Frontend

  • Du löst Bugs und verbesserst Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Sicherheit unserer Web-Anwendungen und Services

  • Je nach Projekt wirkst Du an Cloud-Infrastruktur, CI/CD-Pipelines und Deployment mit

  • Du setzt in Deiner täglichen Arbeit Agentic-Engineering-Tools wie Cursor oder Claude Code ein

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Kunden zusammen, in der Regel remote

  • Du unterstützt Deine Teamkolleg*innen und teilst Learnings und Best Practices Protofy-weit

  • Du beteiligst Dich aktiv an der fachlichen Weiterentwicklung der Organisation

  • Du verfolgst neue Trends in Backend, Web und App und diskutierst ihren Einsatz

Dein Profil

  • Du hast 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, sowohl im Backend als auch in der Web-Entwicklung

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Kotlin, Java oder TypeScript (z. B. Node.js) sowie im Design und Betrieb von APIs (REST und/oder GraphQL)

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Frontend-Entwicklung mit React, Flutter und TypeScript

  • Du hast fundiertes Web-Know-how (HTTP, HTML, CSS, TypeScript/JavaScript) und verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Frontend und Backend

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Design und Einsatz von SQL- und/oder NoSQL-Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL, MongoDB)

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch

Bonus

  • Akademischer Hintergrund in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem anderen relevanten Studiengang (BSc, MSc)

  • Erfahrung mit Kotlin, z. B. mit Spring Boot (unsere bevorzugte Wahl)

  • Erfahrung in der Frontend-Entwicklung mit React und TypeScript

  • Aktiver Einsatz von Agentic-Engineering-Tools wie Claude Code, Cursor oder GitHub Copilot

  • Erfahrung mit automatisierten Unit- und Integrationstests (z. B. JUnit, Kotest, MockK) und Prinzipien der Code-Qualität wie TDD, Code Reviews, KISS oder Separation of Concerns

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (AWS, GCP oder Azure), Docker/Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform), CI/CD sowie Monitoring und Observability

  • Erfahrung in der App-Entwicklung (z. B. Android/Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform, Flutter oder React Native)

  • Erfahrung im Agentur- oder Start-up-Umfeld und mit agilen Methoden wie Pair oder Mob Programming

title: Embedded FW Engineer - Qualcomm SoC
description:
Bragi is the audio platform that enables anyone to build smart audio products people love.
We were founded in Munich in 2013 and invented the true wireless category with The Dash, a full year before AirPods. Since then, we've invested more than $90 million in software and AI, and moved from building our own hardware to building the platform that makes everyone else's hardware smarter.
Today, Bragi brings world-leading services onto audio devices: music platforms, AI providers and productivity tools, all controlled through natural interaction rather than screens and taps. Our platform already supports more than 30 million devices. Partners include Bose, Skullcandy and Tozo, alongside services such as Fireflies, TuneIn, Endel, SoundCloud and many more.
As AI moves off the screen and into the ear, audio is becoming one of the most personal ways people interact with technology. We're building the platform that makes that possible, and the work you do here ships to millions of people.

Embedded Firmware Engineer - Qualcomm SoC

This is a remote role but you are welcome to join us at our Munich office. This role is limited to fixed term for 1 year.

What you'll be working on

  • Prototyping, integration and development of drivers and components in embedded C for customer audio projects (TWS Earbuds, matching charger cases, Headsets, Speakers) according to the product requirements based on the various SoCs, primarily focused on Qualcomm platforms, specifically the S7 platform

  • Hardware/SW configurations and measurements during prototyping and pre-production

  • Developing unit, integration and automation tests to verify software integrity using AI and analysis tools for developement, review and validation to check for potential issues in our codebase

What you'll need

  • 5+ years experience as an Embedded Engineer

  • Strong C coding skills, in particular for embedded systems

  • Experience in design, development and debugging low-level software on embedded targets

  • Worked with some or more of the following QCOMM bluetooth SoCs: QCC51**, QCC309*, QCC71**

  • Familiar with performing ADK (SDK) updates

  • Knowledge of common peripheral interfaces like SPI, UART, I2C and USB

  • Experience in reading sensor datasheets and implementing drivers

  • Hardware familiarity (logic-analyzers, oscilloscopes and power measurement equipment)

  • Willingness to work in dynamic agile teams according to a Scrum or KanBan workflow

  • Fluent in written and spoken English

Strong plus

  • Experience with QCC S7

  • Experience with Bluetooth, Wifi or other wireless communications protocols

  • Experience with development on battery driven devices (memory & power constrained devices)

  • Prior experience working with mobile developers

  • Experience with production processes and support

  • Experience with STM processes

  • Experience with charging topologies

What we offer

  • Complex projects that is exceptionally challenging and will change how audio is consumed forever

  • Work closely with worldwide known audio brands developing the products of tomorrow

  • International setup with 35+ nationalities and great working atmosphere

  • A chance to deliver a delightful experience to 25m+ users in the next 12 months (existing base is 7m+)

  • A flexible Learning & Development program, choose where you want to improve yourself

  • If you are in Munich and want to come to the office we have the usual start-up goodies (breakfast, lunch, beers, events, quizzes) and all sorts of digital fun if you are remote

  • 10 professional coaching sessions with experts to support your growth

  • Work from where suits you best with flexible working hours

title: Senior Software Engineer, SSCS : Authentication
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Help us build the next generation of authentication services at GitLab. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you'll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.

You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.

GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.

Some of our projects include:

  • Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation
  • Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith
  • Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
  • Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
  • Improving service accounts and secure automation
  • Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)

What you'll do

  • Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.
  • Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.
  • Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.
  • Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.
  • Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
  • Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.
  • Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.
  • Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.
  • Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.

What you'll bring

  • Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).
  • Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.
  • Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.
  • Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.
  • Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.

About the team

Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.

Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.

title: Threat Research Engineer
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Threat Research Engineer at GitLab, you'll research emerging security threats and turn your findings into protection for GitLab customers. You'll investigate new attack surfaces, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems, and build systems that help detect threats and improve vulnerability advisories.
This is a full-stack role: you'll take an idea from the first research question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. You'll use AI tools daily and build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection.

What you'll do
  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
  • Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
  • Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
  • Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.
What you'll bring
  • Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with an understanding of package ecosystems and software supply chain attacks.
  • Both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model (LLM) application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).
  • Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices, including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and writing maintainable code.
  • Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
  • The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward, balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.
  • Clear writing for engineers and a general audience, and keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
  • Helpful, but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP); Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entries or published findings; research on AI agents, LLM applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; blogs, talks, or open source security tools; Terraform or OpenTofu; databases or data pipelines at scale; reverse engineering.
  • You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.
About the team
We're the Threat Research group. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning, and publish our findings on the Security Labs blog.
Our work includes research on the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent.

Available Locations: Austin, TX | Seattle, WA | London, UK

About the Role

Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.

You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.

Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.

Responsibilities

  • Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.
  • Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.
  • Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.
  • Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.
  • Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.
  • Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.
  • Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.
  • You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.
  • You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.
  • You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.
  • You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.
  • You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.

Bonus Points

  • You've worked on the internals of PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database and can trace a SQL operation from planning through commit.
  • Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.
  • You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.
  • You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

About the job

Twilio is looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our Platform Engineering organization. SRE owns production health and resiliency at Twilio — we are accountable for whether our services stay available, performant, and recoverable for the customers who build their businesses on us. SREs here are software engineers who focus on reliability: you will architect systems with reliability designed in from the outset, define the SLIs and SLOs that determine whether we are meeting customer expectations, and build the automation that keeps our infrastructure efficiently ahead of capacity and performance demand.

At the Staff SRE you work without day-to-day guidance, applying deep subject-matter knowledge and industry-leading practice to improve the products, processes, and services that Twilio runs on. title: Senior Software Engineer, International
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The International engineering team's mission is to expand Robinhood's products globally and scale our platform to support millions of new customers in diverse markets. We build and maintain experiences across onboarding, funding, account setup, localized product experiences, growth incentives, and platform capabilities to operate in new jurisdictions. Our engineering team partners closely with product, design, compliance, marketing teams, along with an array of platform engineering teams to launch new products and optimize user acquisition globally. We prioritize technical rigor, system reliability, and quick execution to deliver reliable products to our growing customer base. Our culture is centered on clear communication, strong team partnership, and a commitment to helping people manage their financial lives!

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will be a core technical driver for Robinhood’s global expansion initiatives. You will bridge high-performance frontend interfaces with resilient backend distributed systems, architecting and delivering localized customer experiences—from multi-currency funding and international onboarding to regional asset trading. You will design reusable, extensible platform abstractions that allow Robinhood to scale seamlessly into new international markets while upholding uncompromising standards for security, availability, and compliance. In this role, you will lead complex technical designs, raise the engineering bar across the stack, and collaborate side-by-side with product managers, designers, compliance partners, and platform teams to build financial products for our worldwide community

This role is based in either our Toronto, Canada office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Full Stack Architecture & Engineering: Develop and maintain high-quality frontend interfaces (React/TypeScript) and scale robust backend services (Go/Python)
  • Global Product Launches: Own the technical delivery of critical international capabilities, including localized onboarding funnels, identity verification (KYC/AML), multi-currency funding rails, and region-specific trading experiences
  • Growth and User Acquisition: Build and optimize high-leverage growth mechanisms, localized promotion engines, and user acquisition pipelines to accelerate international market adoption.
  • Reusable Internationalization Platforms: Architect modular, scalable frameworks and internationalization (i18n/l10n) services that make expanding to future jurisdictions faster, safer, and more reliable
  • System Reliability & Observability: Ensure backend services and localized products are built for high availability, low latency, and fault tolerance; implement comprehensive telemetry, automated testing, and participate in production on-call rotations
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Design, Compliance, Legal, and Platform teams to translate jurisdictional requirements into elegant, user-centric technical solutions

What you bring

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems across the full stack
  • Frontend Depth: Proficiency with modern frontend technologies and frameworks (e.g., React, TypeScript) with an emphasis on performance, accessibility, and state management
  • Backend & Distributed Systems: Strong experience building scalable distributed services in languages such as Go or Python, utilizing relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis), and working with event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka)
  • Product Ownership: Proven track record of taking complex features from ambiguity through technical design, phased rollout, production validation, and post-launch maintenance
  • API & Systems Design: Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, gRPC, service-oriented architectures, and microservice integration patterns
  • Communication & Alignment: Clear, structured communication skills to articulate trade-offs, drive technical consensus across distributed teams, and align with non-technical stakeholders

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career

  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership

  • Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs

  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not

  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.

  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!

  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

  • Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs

Our team is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming interview experience for all candidates. If you require a specific accommodation during the application or interview process due to a physical or mental condition, please complete this Applicant Accommodation Form to notify our team. The form should only be completed if you need a specific accommodation.

$166,000—$195,000 CAD

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
region: New York City, NY / San Francisco, CA / Seattle, WA
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a member of the GTM team at Anthropic, you will be a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers and leads the technical direction of their AI adoption. Customers bring you in to lead, not only to implement: you decide what should be built, and then make sure it gets built well. You will work with customer teams to ship advanced AI applications that solve real world business problems, and guide the architecture and advisory work that surrounds those builds across an account.

Working closely with our Research, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and help shape our forward-deployed motion as it scales. We expect Staff FDEs to set direction under ambiguity and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. In this role, you guide architecture and build initiatives across workstreams, working directly with senior technical and business stakeholders and owning outcomes that span an account's roadmap.

You don't need to have shipped agents to production. You do need deep experience building and operating production systems, hands-on time with agents, and the judgment to lead architecture and advisory work with enterprise customers.

Responsibilities

  • Own technical strategy for a key account or vertical, in partnership with account and product teams.
  • Guide technical architecture and design decisions across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Lead discovery and advisory engagements independently, shaping scope and technical strategy before a build starts.
  • Lead engagements delivered with partners, setting the architecture and the quality bar for work you don't build yourself.
  • Review designs and unblock other FDEs on hard technical calls.
  • Represent Anthropic to senior technical and business stakeholders, including VPs and C-level, to align on strategy and de-risk delivery.
  • Own your engagements end to end: scope the work, sequence it, unblock it, anticipate security and procurement gates, and deliver production systems the customer can operate.
  • Work within customer systems to build production applications and agent components with Claude, and hand over systems the customer can run.
  • Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams.
  • Build long term relationships with customers and proactively identify new opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement.
  • Travel frequently (25%) to customer sites to build in person with customers.
  • Be a champion for Anthropic's mission in the field.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • Deep system design and problem decomposition skills: you can walk into a discovery conversation with only a business problem and leave with a defensible technical strategy for a secure, production-ready design inside a complex enterprise environment of legacy systems, with identity and access, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience in a senior technical, customer facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, or as a Tech Lead with consulting or product experience. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply.
  • A track record as the person a team turns to on ambiguous technical calls, whether through architecture review, pairing, or informal mentorship.
  • A track record of directly influencing senior technical and business stakeholders, including VP and C-level, in complex organizations.
  • Extensive experience building and operating production systems. Hands-on experience with LLMs and agents is expected. Side projects and prototypes count.
  • Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python (and ideally in one or more additional languages like TypeScript, Java, etc), experience shipping production applications, and everyday use of AI coding tools with the judgment to review and steer.
  • Experience leading advisory and architecture-review engagements as well as hands-on builds, and running them end to end.
  • High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity present in complex organizations, and the learning velocity to pick up new domains and tools fast.
  • Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications.
  • A background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical are nice to have.

title: Staff Software Engineer: Compute
region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Frontier AI runs on datacenters, and the world is in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout in a generation. The binding constraint on progress is increasingly everything around the chips: land, power, permits, equipment, and the design and construction of the buildings themselves. Bringing a single site online involves hundreds of people, thousands of components, and decisions that move enormous amounts of capital. Much of that work still runs on spreadsheets and handoffs.

At Anthropic, we're building software and Claude-powered tools to help Anthropic scale out its compute, and we think there's an enormous opportunity to rethink how that work gets done. It's early, it's already having a real impact, and the engineers who join now will shape how one of the most consequential buildouts in the world gets done.

We're looking for strong, versatile software engineers who love building for people doing real work in the physical world. You'll embed with the teams that source sites, design buildings, procure equipment, and manage construction, learn their work deeply, and build the tools and systems they rely on every day. Datacenter experience is a big plus, but what matters most is that you can earn the trust of expert operators, model a messy domain cleanly, and move fast.

Responsibilities

  • Build the core systems that track a datacenter's lifecycle (sites, designs, bills of materials, equipment, and construction progress) in one trusted, permissioned source of truth
  • Embed with datacenter, energy, and supply chain teams to understand how the work actually gets done, find the critical path, and build the tools they reach for first
  • Bring order to messy data by migrating and reconciling spreadsheets and legacy trackers, and integrate with the industry's tools, like construction management, scheduling, and engineering systems
  • Design for trust: fine-grained permissions, auditability, and data quality for information that steers major investment decisions
  • Ship early, iterate with users, and cut anything that doesn't help bring compute online sooner
  • Partner with research to understand new model capabilities and share where they fall short in engineering-heavy, physical-world domains

  • Have 8+ years of experience building software, with strong full-stack skills and solid grounding in data modeling, APIs, and databases
  • Have built software that teams in a physical-world industry depend on, such as datacenters, construction, energy, manufacturing, supply chain, or logistics
  • Have a track record of zero-to-one work in startup or startup-like environments
  • Are deeply user-centric: you learn the domain from the people doing the work and validate with them before over-investing
  • Bring high agency and good judgment about what matters, and hold strong opinions loosely
  • Communicate clearly across engineering, operations, and research, and care about the societal impacts of your work

Strong candidates may also have

  • Experience in datacenters (at a hyperscaler, colocation provider, operator, utility, or engineering firm), or in adjacent fields like construction, logistics, or legal
  • Experience with the domain's tooling, such as construction management (Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud), scheduling (Primavera P6), PLM/BOM, ERP and procurement, CAD/BIM, DCIM, or power system studies
  • A background in electrical, mechanical, or civil engineering, energy systems, or supply chain alongside a software career
  • Experience building products with large language models

  • 100% of the skills listed above

  • Direct machine learning or AI research experience

Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Beijing, China

About the Role

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As the architectural complexity of enterprise solutions scales, we are evolving how we partner with our customers. The Customer Engineer (CE) represents the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted advisor who owns the technical relationship from the initial discovery phase through to long-term adoption and ongoing account expansion.

Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to the Regional Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, utilizing AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, build bespoke architectures, and deliver compelling product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) across Cloudflare’s portfolio (Security, Networking, Zero Trust and Developer Platforms).
  • Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion.
  • Strategic Alignment: Own the long-term technical relationship across the entire customer lifecycle, ensuring continuous alignment between the customer’s evolving business goals and our product roadmap.
  • Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. You will be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.
  • AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Act as an "AI-Augmented" engineer. Leverage AI agents and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, and basic telemetry monitoring, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer.
  • Technical Acumen: Broad technical expertise spanning web security, networking (routing, DNS, DDoS mitigation), cloud infrastructure, and enterprise architecture.
  • Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.
  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")

  • Cloudflare Developer Stack Experience: Hands-on experience building, deploying, or architecting solutions using Cloudflare's developer platform and AI ecosystem, specifically Workers AI and AI Gateway.
  • Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with prompt engineering, Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.

Compensation This role features a competitive base salary and a variable commission structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Available Locations

This is a one-to-many motion. Rather than embedding full-time with a single account, you'll work in parallel, bringing patterns, reference implementations, lessons learned from across your portfolio to every customer you work with. Customers come to us building on the developer platform, but when we engage we support the full breadth of the Cloudflare platform.

  • Diagnose and resolve hard technical problems across the stack, removing the blockers between customers and a successful launch.

Cloudflare Browser Isolation runs web content in remote browsers, helping protect users from threats while preserving a responsive browsing experience. Our team builds the Chromium-based browsing engine, remote rendering and streaming technology, and distributed services that manage browser sessions across Cloudflare’s global network.

You will work at the intersection of systems programming, distributed systems, and security. Engineers contribute across the product, collaborating on browser changes, service orchestration, observability, and build infrastructure.

Scope and growth

At this level, you will be accountable for outcomes across a problem area that may span several components. You will establish technical direction, make uncertainty and trade-offs explicit, and help other engineers succeed while remaining hands-on. This is an individual-contributor role; people-management experience is not required.

Technologies we use

  • Browser engine: Chromium and C++.
  • Systems programming: Rust.
  • Distributed services and orchestration: Go, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Nomad, and Consul.
  • Remote rendering and streaming: WebRTC and Skia.
  • Browser client: TypeScript, WebAssembly, and WebGL.

What you will do

  • Lead complex, multi-component initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, staged rollout, and measurable production outcomes.
  • Design and implement changes in our Chromium-based C++ browser and the distributed services and systems components supporting remote browsing, working across Go, Rust, and TypeScript.
  • Make and explain architectural trade-offs across latency, availability, resource efficiency, security boundaries, and operational complexity.
  • Investigate difficult cross-layer failures and performance bottlenecks, distinguishing browser, host, network, and control-plane causes.
  • Improve resilience, capacity management, observability, and release safety; define success metrics and validate results.
  • Coordinate work with partner teams, surface dependencies and risks early, and guide delivery through ambiguity.
  • Mentor engineers and raise the quality of code reviews, design reviews, testing, documentation, and operational practices.
  • Participate in the team’s production on-call rotation after onboarding, lead technical incident investigations as needed, and drive durable corrective actions.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Principal Engineer.

About the job

The Compliance Experiences team sits at the heart of the Twilio platform, owning two critical domains: Phone Numbers and Compliance (KYC).

In 2026, "getting a phone number" is no longer a simple API call; it requires sophisticated orchestration across global phone number inventory, real-time identity verification, regulatory compliance, and operational tooling at massive scale.

Twilio’s KYC Platform, the gateway to accessing all of Twilio’s communication APIs, enables customers to securely provision and operate communication services globally while navigating complex, constantly evolving regulatory requirements.

As a Principal Engineer (P5), you will own the technical strategy for a platform that processes millions of requests. You will be expected to pioneer AI-driven development workflows using LLMs and agentic agents to accelerate code generation, automate architectural reviews, and synthesize complex global telecommunications regulations into executable logic. Your mission is to collapse the distance between a great idea and a production ready feature.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • DRAW THE OWL: Lead the architecture and long-term technical roadmap, transitioning legacy systems into a modern, distributed microservices architecture that supports global scale.
  • ACCELERATE WITH AI: Lead by example in using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, or internal LLMs) to automate boilerplate, generate exhaustive test suites, and perform rapid prototyping. You will be measured on your ability to amplify your own output and the team's velocity through AI augmentation.
  • BE AN OWNER: Drive technical excellence across multiple teams, making critical architectural decisions that balance rapid feature innovation with world-class reliability and security.
  • WEAR THE CUSTOMER’S SHOES: Partner with Product Managers to translate complex global telecommunications regulations and customer needs into elegant, developer-first APIs and application workflows.
  • EMPOWER OTHERS: Mentor and uplift senior and staff engineers. Foster a culture of technical curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. Teach the team how to move from "writing code" to "reviewing and orchestrating AI-generated logic" without sacrificing security or quality.
  • RUTHLESSLY PRIORITIZE: Identify and mitigate technical risks early, ranging from scalability bottlenecks to security vulnerabilities and lead the team through complex production incidents with a focus on long-term remediation.
  • WRITE IT DOWN: Communicate complex technical strategies to both executive leadership and engineering teams through high-quality design documents, RFCs, and presentations.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 16+ years of experience designing and developing highly available, high scale, secure, mission-critical cloud native enterprise distributed systems.
  • Expert Proficiency in Java or Go, with deep knowledge of AWS ecosystems (Lambda, EKS, DynamoDB, Kafka).
  • Architectural Mastery: Deep experience with cloud-native infrastructure (AWS preferred), microservices patterns, and designing "five-nines" (99.999%) resilient systems.
  • AI-Native Workflow: Demonstrated experience using AI tools to significantly accelerate software delivery. You should be comfortable discussing how you use LLMs for architectural brainstorming, debugging, and code synthesis.
  • API Excellence: A track record of building and maintaining high-volume public-facing APIs that focus on exceptional developer experience.
  • Data Savvy: Experience with high-throughput data processing and storage solutions (SQL/NoSQL, Redis, Kafka, or Spark).
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Kubernetes, Terraform, and modern CI/CD paradigms.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to influence technical strategy across multiple teams and organizational boundaries without direct authority.

Desired:

  • Telecom Domain Expertise: Experience with telephony protocols, local number porting (LNP), or global regulatory compliance frameworks.
  • Platform Thinking: Experience building "internal platforms" that enable other developer teams to move faster.
  • Agentic Systems: Experience building or integrating AI agents into internal developer platforms or automated ops workflows.

Location

This role will be remote across USA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation
Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $188,240.00 - $235,300.00.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $199,280.00 - $249,100.00.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $221,360.00 - $276,700.00.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

title: SoC Engineer
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops custom silicon and systems for advanced AI workloads. Our first-party accelerator team works across chip architecture, design, software, and systems to build the computing platforms that power frontier models. We are a small, dynamic team that values technical breadth, hands-on engineering, and creative approaches to building complex hardware.

About the Role

We’re looking for a SoC Engineer to help architect, design, and integrate OpenAI’s first-party AI accelerators. You will build the processor, interconnect, I/O, and platform infrastructure that connects our accelerator designs into complete, functional systems.

This role combines architectural judgment with hands-on implementation. You’ll work closely with design, architecture, verification, and software teams throughout development, from defining subsystem requirements and integrating IP to pre-silicon validation, silicon bring-up, and post-silicon debug. You should enjoy stretching across domains, rolling up your sleeves, and doing the work needed to make a complex system function end to end.

In this role, you will:

  • Define and implement SoC architectures spanning embedded processors, AMBA interconnects, peripheral subsystems, PCI Express, Ethernet and die-to-die interfaces.

  • Develop the microarchitecture and RTL design of subsystems supporting I/O and SoC functionality.

  • Integrate Arm Cortex-M and Cortex-A processors, AXI/APB fabrics, and third-party controller IP, including the RTL and glue logic needed to connect these components.

  • Develop reset and boot architectures, working with firmware and software teams to define sequencing, initialization, and survivability behavior.

  • Incorporate debug, test, and security requirements into the SoC architecture and implementation, partnering with other silicon designers to make the silicon observable, testable, and secure.

  • Drive PCIe and other I/O integration, including controller and PHY interfaces, high-speed SerDes, and die-to-die connectivity.

  • Contribute to power management and security architecture and design.

  • Work directly with third-party IP vendors to define technical requirements, evaluate IP capabilities, coordinate deliverables, and resolve issues from integration through silicon bring-up.

  • Work across architecture, design, verification, physical design, and software teams to define interfaces, resolve integration issues, and carry designs through pre-silicon validation and post-silicon bring-up.

  • Work closely with Firmware and Software teams to define boot, configuration and runtime behavior and functionality.

  • Build and apply automation and AI-assisted tools to accelerate design, IP integration, consistency checking, and debugging while maintaining engineering quality.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience in SoC architecture, RTL design, and subsystem or full-chip integration, with hands-on ownership through implementation and silicon bring-up.

  • Are familiar with Arm processor subsystems, including Cortex-M and Cortex-A, and AMBA protocols and interconnects such as AXI and APB.

  • Understand PCIe protocols and have experience configuring, integrating, and debugging controller IP.

  • Have experience integrating high-speed I/O, including SerDes/PHY interfaces and die-to-die links.

  • Have experience working directly with third-party IP vendors to evaluate technical fit, communicate requirements, and drive integration and debug issues to resolution.

  • Understand reset and boot architecture and the interactions between hardware, firmware, and software during initialization and recovery.

  • Have experience designing for debug, test, and security, and can reason about how these requirements affect the broader system.

  • Are comfortable writing and debugging Verilog/SystemVerilog and building scripts or tools to make integration work more efficient and reliable.

  • Enjoy stretching into multiple domains, learning unfamiliar parts of a system, and rolling up your sleeves to build and debug.

  • Enjoy working on a small, dynamic team where priorities evolve and engineers take broad ownership.

  • Are excited about creatively applying automation and AI tools to hardware design and integration work.

To comply with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidates for this role may need to meet certain legal status requirements as provided in those laws and regulations.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Tokenization team's mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. We work at the intersection of blockchain technology, financial market infrastructure, and modern distributed systems - with a focus on accessibility, security, and scalability. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; we're building the infrastructure that changes that.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and build the core systems that issue, custody, and settle tokenized equities on-chain and keep them in sync with traditional brokerage and ledger systems. You'll lead technically complex projects end to end, make architectural decisions on a foundational Robinhood initiative, and work in a domain where correctness is non-negotiable - the systems you build move real customer assets, continuously, across multiple chains and jurisdictions.

This role are based in either our Menlo Park, Toronto or New York city offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

  • Design, build, and operate the backend services that mint, custody, and settle tokenized equities across leading blockchains, with correctness and auditability as hard requirements
  • Own large, technically complex projects end to end - design, implementation, rollout, and operating what you ship in a 24/7 system
  • Build the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure (brokerage, ledgers, corporate actions) and on-chain systems, including smart contract integrations, chain indexers, and DEX trade flows
  • Partner with product, compliance, legal, and platform teams to turn regulatory constraints into workable system design
  • Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship

What you bring

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including a track record of delivering large-scale distributed systems in production
  • Expertise in backend development with Go, Python, or Java, and deep familiarity with cloud-native architecture (Kafka, Postgres, Kubernetes, or equivalents)
  • Strong instincts for correctness-critical systems - idempotency, reconciliation, and reasoning carefully about failure modes when money is at stake
  • Demonstrated ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional projects, with the judgment to make tradeoffs and drive alignment
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction beyond your own projects
  • Working knowledge of blockchain fundamentals - EVM, smart contracts, wallets, on-chain settlement - or a strong appetite to go deep quickly

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

Anthropic's Corporate Systems team runs the core collaboration platforms everyone here works in and builds the tooling and automation behind IT. That responsibility extends to the companies we acquire. Their people, devices, and systems have to come into Anthropic securely.

title: Software Engineer, Observability & Profiling
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking Software Engineers to join our Observability team within the Infrastructure organization. The Observability team owns the monitoring and telemetry infrastructure that every engineer and researcher at Anthropic depends on—from metrics and logging pipelines to distributed tracing, profiling, error analytics, alerting, and the dashboards and query interfaces that make it all actionable. By joining this team, you'll have a direct impact on the reliability and operational excellence of Anthropic's research and product systems.

As Anthropic scales its infrastructure across massive GPU, TPU, and Trainium clusters, the volume and complexity of operational data is growing by orders of magnitude—and an increasing share of the hardest problems live below the application layer. We're building next-generation observability systems—high-throughput telemetry pipelines, fleet-wide continuous profiling, eBPF-based tracing and network visibility, and agentic diagnostic tools—so engineers can detect, diagnose, and resolve issues in minutes rather than hours, even when the answer lies in the kernel, the network stack, or an accelerator rather than on a dashboard.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable telemetry ingest and storage pipelines for metrics, logs, traces, and error data across Anthropic's multi-cluster infrastructure
  • Build observability solutions that give engineers deep, low-overhead visibility into system behavior across the fleet
  • Own and evolve core observability platforms, driving migrations and architectural improvements that improve reliability, reduce cost, and scale with organizational growth
  • Build instrumentation libraries, SDKs, and eBPF-based auto-instrumentation to emit high-quality telemetry, with and without code changes
  • Reduce mean time to detection and resolution by building cross-signal correlation—from kernel-level events up to application traces—unified query interfaces, and AI-assisted diagnostic tooling
  • Drive fleet-wide efficiency by turning continuous profiling and utilization telemetry into actionable optimization insights across CPU, memory, and accelerator fleets
  • Partner with Research, Inference, Product, and Infrastructure teams to ensure observability solutions meet the unique needs of each organization

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the role

As a CE Specialist you will be the trusted technical advisor for customers adopting Cloudflare's network services. These include Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall and Cloudflare Network Interconnect (CNI), alongside Cloudflare One. You will lead Magic Transit and Cloudflare WAN POCs from design through to production cutover. You will also help customers modernize how they protect, connect and secure their networks and sites.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers choose the right Cloudflare network and security solution for their business needs.
  • Lead qualified prospects through Solution Design and POC.
    • Magic Transit: plan and run POCs covering BGP onboarding, prefix advertisement, GRE/IPsec tunnels or CNI, and DDoS validation.
    • Cloudflare WAN: plan and run POCs covering site and branch connectivity (IPsec/GRE tunnels, CNI, Cloudflare One Appliance), data center and cloud-to-site connectivity, routing design, and coexistence with or migration from existing SD-WAN or MPLS.
  • Understand the customer's network topology, IP addressing, routing policy and security requirements. Then design an architecture that fits, including hybrid environments with Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Run technical discovery, demos and workshops as part of the pre-sales cycle. Support RFP/RFI responses and technical validation.
  • Explain the benefits of Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN and Cloudflare One compared with alternative approaches. These include traditional DDoS scrubbing services, appliance-based protection, SD-WAN solutions, next-generation firewalls and MPLS or traditional WAN.
  • Work with GTM partners to consistently achieve pipeline and revenue goals.
  • Present network and security transformation messages to senior technical leaders and executives.
  • Capture product and feature gaps and feed them back to Product and Engineering.

Core requirements

  • GTM experience: 5+ years in Customer Engineering, Pre-sales, Solutions or Systems Engineering, or Technical Sales. You should have experience guiding customers through discovery, solution design, POC and handover to delivery or support.
  • BGP and routing: Strong working knowledge of BGP (eBGP, route advertisement and filtering, AS paths, communities, anycast, RPKI and route hygiene). You should also be comfortable with static and dynamic routing, subnetting, route-based policy and split tunnels.
  • TCP/IP: Deep understanding of the TCP/IP protocol stack and packet-level troubleshooting (for example with tcpdump and Wireshark). This includes MTU/MSS, tunneling (GRE, IPsec), NAT and asymmetric routing.
  • DDoS protection: Understanding of L3/L4/L7 DDoS attack types and mitigation approaches (for example volumetric floods, SYN floods, amplification and reflection attacks). You should also understand how on-demand and always-on protection differ.
  • SD-WAN and WAN architecture: Familiarity with SD-WAN architectures and routing protocols (BGP and OSPF overlays), underlay and overlay design, local internet breakout, branch connectivity, and migration from MPLS or legacy WAN.
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to manage a project, work to deadlines and prioritize between competing goals.
  • Curiosity and learning agility. Cloudflare sits at the cutting edge of internet technology, so you are expected to keep up with industry trends as well as our own products.

Desirable skills

Network and security fundamentals

  • DNS: Good knowledge of DNS, including authoritative and recursive resolution, DNSSEC, DNS over HTTPS/TLS, DNS-based attacks (such as tunneling and cache poisoning) and DNS filtering.
  • Detailed understanding of the path from user to application, including hybrid and multi-cloud architectures (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Knowledge of end-user and application security risks. These include DDoS, malware, phishing, viruses, ransomware.
  • VPN and remote access challenges, and moving to Zero Trust access.
  • SIEM and log analytics platforms. You should also be comfortable with network telemetry such as NetFlow and sFlow.
  • Experience and knowledge with network and security vendors, including Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Check Point (covering architecture, capabilities, configuration, and troubleshooting).

Market and competitive knowledge

  • Understanding of the market for CDN providers, Web Application Firewalls, remote access solutions, next-generation firewalls, CASB, DDoS mitigation, SD-WAN and secure gateway solutions.

Cloudflare One and Zero Trust

  • SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.
  • Knowledge of Cloudflare Zero Trust solutions: Access, Gateway, Browser Isolation, and WARP client deployment.
  • Secure Web Gateway, CASB and DLP.
  • IdP and authentication (SAML, OTP), plus SaaS application integration and tenant controls.
  • Client OS fundamentals and software distribution.

Compensation

  • For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €74,000 - €106,000.

Equity

  • This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations.   • Serve as the primary subject-matter expert and developer for Cloudflare’s O2C and R2R technology stack (NetSuite, Zuora RevPro, Oracle Fusion).

  • Manage application environments (e.g., Production vs. Sandbox/Release Preview), ensuring alignment across all environments from both a data and release perspective to support safe testing of financial changes.

  • Act as the Subject-Matter Expert for integrations across the QTC, O2C, and R2R lifecycles. Ensure the seamless flow of data (e.g., syncing closed-won opportunities to NetSuite/Oracle, passing billing data to Zuora RevPro, and ensuring subledger transactions map flawlessly to the GL).
  • Design, build, and deploy custom system enhancements, automated billing schedules, journal entry automations, revenue allocation scripts (e.g., SuiteScript), and API integrations between our platforms.
  • Lead the evaluation, implementation, and governance of native AI features within the financial stack (e.g., AI-driven anomaly detection in journal entries and revenue schedules, automated cash application matching, or intelligent account reconciliations) to accelerate financial operations.
  • Proactively monitor vendors' quarterly updates and product roadmaps. Lead impact assessments, manage versioning/upgrades, and educate Finance stakeholders on new functionality and AI opportunities.

  • Build and maintain scalable system architectures that support complex, high-volume recurring billing, usage-based consumption models, and multi-entity global consolidations.

  • Maintain comprehensive system architecture documentation, process maps, and business continuity/disaster recovery plans for critical financial systems.

  • Process-Oriented: A deep understanding of core Order-to-Cash (O2C), Revenue Recognition (ASC 606), and Record-to-Report (R2R) business processes, including global consolidations and the month-end close cycle.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to partner effectively with Finance/Accounting leadership and bridge the gap between technical architecture and financial outcomes.

description:
About Us

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code.
